# package devmgmt

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/devmgmt"
```

Package devmgmt is a KNXnet/IP device management client: it reads and writes the interface object properties of a KNXnet/IP server (local device management with M\_PropRead and M\_PropWrite) over a device management connection.

	c, err := devmgmt.Dial(ctx, "192.168.1.10")
	name, err := c.PropRead(ctx, devmgmt.ObjectKNXnetIPParameter, 1, devmgmt.PIDFriendlyName, 1, 30)
